context: A police officer briefs on workplace safety
purpose: Teach: 工務/自給/話し合う/書き換え/増設/換気/量販/退社

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社の工務関係、安全基準、再確認をお願いします。
lines.en: I'll need you to recheck the safety standards for your contracting work.
lines.style: Professional, measured. Even tone. Speaks with the authority of protocol, not criticism. Direct eye contact. Pace is steady, deliberate—each phrase lands clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。自給型の食材保管、衛生面で話し合う必要があります。
lines.en: Yes. We need to go over hygiene procedures for the self-sufficient food storage system.
lines.style: Responsive and engaged. Slight forward lean. Acknowledges the severity without defensiveness. Voice is clear and ready—notes being taken internally. Respectful pace.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 契約書の書き換え時、警察への届出が必要な場合も。
lines.en: When you're rewriting the contract, there may be cases where we need to file a report with us.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, procedural. No inflection—this is information, not warning. Monotone delivery keeps it administrative. Brief pause before the final phrase to let it register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: カメラ増設、換気の改善、近日中に着手します。
lines.en: We'll get cameras installed and improve the ventilation system starting right away.
lines.style: Assured and action-oriented. Crisp attack on the opening. Spoken with quiet confidence—not boasting, just committing. Even rhythm, no hesitation. Nods slightly on 'starting.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 量販店並みの規模なので、退社時刻の戸締り、厳重に。
lines.en: Given the scale you're operating at—nearly retail-grade—door locks and closing procedures need to be airtight.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Slight emphasis on 'airtight.' Clinical tone. The language shifts to final-protocol register. Slower on the close. This is the non-negotiable part—delivered level, unmoved.
